description: Gates, guards, estate fees, vigilante contributions, dogs, bars on windows. A recurring cost that replaces a public service.
energy_note: Paying, monthly, for something taxes were meant to cover.

aspect: Communities formed militias for the same reason
description: Several farmer and herder communities have formed armed groups, allegedly in response to a lack of government protection - which raises the ambient level of weaponry and the next round of casualties.

aspect: Women pay a movement tax instead of a money one
description: Where cash is not available, the security adaptation is restriction: not travelling after dark, not going alone, not taking that road. It costs opportunity rather than naira and nobody records it.
energy_note: A curfew nobody announced and everybody keeps.

description: NGN 15,000 a month for the gate, the guards and the generator for the street lights. It is not optional in any meaningful sense and it is not a tax, so it appears in no measure of what she pays for public services.
energy_note: A private tax, monthly, for a public good.
